game.label: Your own inFAMOUS 2 from the PlayStation Store (NPUA80638) with its 1.03 update, as RPCS3 installed it: the NPUA80638 folder in RPCS3's dev_hdd0/game. The licence (.rap) is found in RPCS3 on its own. The disc release (BCUS98125) doesn't work yet.

prepare.label: Building the game for your Mac from your copy (the first time takes 10 to 30 minutes and about 2 GB; macOS may ask once to install Apple's Command Line Tools, and missing build tools are installed with Homebrew)

settings.label: Window
settings.help: Full screen is macOS's own (its own Space). Borderless covers the screen without changing Spaces.

settings.label: Window size
settings.help: The size the game's window opens at.

settings.label: V-Sync
settings.help: On waits for the screen's refresh: no tearing.

settings.label: Resolution
settings.help: What the game draws at. 720p is the PS3's own; higher is sharper and needs a faster Mac.

settings.label: Aspect
settings.help: Ultrawide shows more to the sides; the HUD stays 16:9 in the middle.

settings.label: Upscaling
settings.help: How the picture is fitted to the window. MetalFX is Apple's upscaler (macOS 13 or newer).

settings.label: Anti-aliasing
settings.help: Smooths jagged edges. SMAA is sharper than FXAA and costs a little more.

settings.label: Texture filtering
settings.help: Keeps streets and walls sharp at shallow angles.

settings.label: Language
settings.help: The dub, the subtitles and the menus.

settings.label: Button prompts
settings.help: The buttons the game shows. Automatic follows the controller in use.

settings.label: Show FPS
settings.help: The frame rate in the window's title.

actions.label: Saves
actions.help: Your inFAMOUS 2 save slots, as the game writes them (BCUS98125...).

actions.label: Logs
actions.help: game.log (the last session) and setup.log (the last setup).

actions.label: Shader cache
actions.help: Shaders the game has built, so later sessions don't stutter. Clearing only helps if the picture looks wrong after an update.

exit_codes.40: Your copy isn't one this port builds from: it needs your own inFAMOUS 2 from the PlayStation Store (NPUA80638) with its 1.03 update, as RPCS3 installed it (the NPUA80638 folder in dev_hdd0/game). Version 01.00: install the 1.03 update in RPCS3 first (File > Install Packages/Raps/Edats, the update's .pkg). The disc release doesn't work yet. Pick it again on the game's page.
exit_codes.41: Your Mac needs something first: Apple's Command Line Tools (their installer opened: finish it), Homebrew (brew.sh) for the build tools, RPCS3 with the PS3 firmware installed (it decrypts the game once), or more free disk space. The setup's last lines say which; then set the game up again.
exit_codes.42: Couldn't download what the build needs (the toolkit from GitHub, its Python packages or the build tools). Check the internet connection and set the game up again.
exit_codes.43: Building the game failed. Set it up again: it continues where it stopped. setup.log in the logs folder says why.
exit_codes.44: inFAMOUS 2 is already running, or another setup or rebuild of it is. Close it or wait for it, then try again.
exit_codes.45: The game isn't built yet. Set it up again on the game's page (the first time takes 10 to 30 minutes).
exit_codes.46: The inFAMOUS 2 launcher couldn't do it. Open the launcher itself (Advanced > Install / rebuild) to see why.
exit_codes.47: Your licence for the game (its .rap file) wasn't found. RPCS3 keeps it in dev_hdd0/home/<user>/exdata once the game is installed there; or put the .rap next to the game's folder. Then set the game up again.
